decisions.statement: A repeat of an error raises a count rather than adding a second entry.
An entry has the first time and the last time the error was seen.
An entry names the account and the character that saw the error.
An entry names the world the error was seen in.
An entry has the game version and the API version that raised the error.
An entry names the add-on blamed for the error and the build of that add-on.
Nothing here has code that runs.

definition: the shape a captured error takes, counted and blamed on the add-on that raised it
